mapper.sql: select m.manual_id as "manualId", m.manual_type as "manualType", m.version as "version", m.target_user as "targetUser", m.effective_date as "effectiveDate", mf.original_file_name as "originalFileName", not exists ( select 1 from manuals newer where newer.manual_type = m.manual_type and newer.target_user = m.target_user and newer.effective_date <= #{effectiveDate} and newer.effective_date > m.effective_date ) as "latest", m.created_at as "createdAt", m.created_by as "createdBy", m.updated_at as "updatedAt", m.updated_by as "updatedBy" from manuals m left join manual_files mf on mf.manual_id = m.manual_id
mapper.select: order by m.manual_type, m.target_user, m.effective_date desc, m.version desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select m.manual_id as "manualId", m.manual_type as "manualType", m.version as "version", m.target_user as "targetUser", m.effective_date as "effectiveDate", mf.original_file_name as "originalFileName", false as "latest", m.created_at as "createdAt", m.created_by as "createdBy", m.updated_at as "updatedAt", m.updated_by as "updatedBy" from manuals m left join manual_files mf on mf.manual_id = m.manual_id where m.manual_type = #{manualType} and m.target_user = #{targetUser} and m.version = #{version}
mapper.insert: insert into manuals (manual_type, version, target_user, effective_date, created_by, updated_by, change_reason) values (#{manualType}, #{version}, #{targetUser}, #{effectiveDate}, #{userId}, #{userId}, #{changeReason})
insert into manual_files (manual_id, original_file_name, internal_storage_name, file_content, created_by) values (#{manualId}, #{originalFileName}, #{internalStorageName}, #{fileContent}, #{userId})
mapper.select: select m.manual_id as "manualId", mf.original_file_name as "originalFileName", mf.file_content as "fileContent" from manuals m join manual_files mf on mf.manual_id = m.manual_id where m.manual_id = #{manualId}
